title: Carry plan revisions through JetBrains commands
description: Objective: deliver the primary IDE model/wire contract consumed by the reviewed-dialog slice. Deliverable in moe-jetbrains: src/main/kotlin/com/moe/model/Models.kt stores planRevision without Int truncation; util/MoeJson.kt preserves it in BOTH parseTasks/full-snapshot and parseTask/incremental paths; services/MoeCommandSender.kt and MoeProjectService.kt expose optional expectedPlanRevision and forward supplied values unchanged. Represent valid revisions as Long within JS safe-integer range 0..9007199254740991; missing task field is legacy effective 0, malformed present field must remain distinguishable/unusable rather than silently becoming 0. Model can use nullable Long with default 0 for that distinction. Omitted command argument keeps old JSON shape (never a null token); explicit 0 and supplied revisions appear in APPROVE_TASK. Make sender/facade report whether command was sent so the dialog can retain UI on disconnection, without interpreting transport send as daemon approval. Validate invalid numeric arguments before send and preserve existing disconnected callback; send failures propagate to the caller's error path. Own new src/test/kotlin/com/moe/services/PlanApprovalContractTest.kt exercising real production parsers/serializer. Dependencies include the two daemon producers and task-e7f534f147b74650ba06c2b98c022afb (blocker parser after budget retirement), to serialize overlapping Models/MoeJson work. NOT in scope: PlanReviewDialog UX, other legacy approval entry points, daemon edits, broad parser refactors. Exact gate at repo root on Windows: cmd /d /c "cd /d moe-jetbrains && gradlew.bat test"; on macOS/Linux: cd moe-jetbrains && ./gradlew test. Serialize shared Gradle output via Moe resource protocol if occupied; do not clean peer build state. Record nonzero JUnit counts and an old-behavior red test.
definitionOfDone: JUnit proves full snapshot and incremental task parsing preserve revision 0, normal values and values above Int range exactly; absent legacy task field means 0.
JUnit proves null, fractional, negative, string/boolean and out-of-safe-range revision input cannot become an approvable 0 or truncated revision.
Production APPROVE_TASK JSON includes an explicitly supplied expectedPlanRevision unchanged (including 0); legacy one-argument calls omit the key entirely, proven by serializer tests.

Sender/facade return send success versus disconnected refusal; tests prove no packet on disconnection or invalid revision, existing disconnected notification preserved, and send exceptions are not claimed as approval.
Fresh Gradle test exits 0 with nonzero JUnit counts; the scoped regression fails against old parsing/serialization, and no peer parser changes are discarded.
taskRails: JetBrains first; never fetch a newer revision from service state to replace the caller's reviewed token.
Both MoeJson parser paths are mandatory; no Int/coercive revision parsing.
Wait for blocker-model prerequisite delivery to avoid shared-file overlap.

implementationPlan.description: Load test-driven-development and create JUnit 4 PlanApprovalContractTest.kt before implementation. Use JsonParser with raw numeric JSON literals and exercise BOTH MoeJson.parseState({tasks:[fixture,validControl]}) and MoeJson.parseTask(fixture); assert identity/count and independent expected results, never only parser equality. For an assertion-red that compiles on the old Task, inspect GsonBuilder().serializeNulls().create().toJsonTree(actualTask), assert planRevision key existence and exact numeric/null values. Named coverage: snapshot and incremental revisions preserve 0, 17, 2147483648, 4294967297 and 9007199254740991; absent legacy field is exactly 0; malformed present null, -1, fractions (including 9007199254740991.1), strings including numeric strings, booleans, arrays/objects, 9007199254740992 and Long overflow are null without dropping or corrupting the task/control. Include integral decimal/exponent literals 1.0 and 1e3, huge positive/negative exponents, and successive valid/malformed/missing payloads to forbid cached fallback. Add direct sender tests that compile with the existing signature: capture real APPROVE_TASK packet from approveTask(id), assert exact type/payload/taskId with no revision key, and assert a sentinel transport exception propagates (old sendMessage currently swallows it). A capturing callback can end in true (compatible with the new Boolean transport contract). Before every Gradle invocation coordinate the shared slot via Moe list_resources/acquire_resource and the actual agreed peer resource id; if no resource exists, agree on a common JetBrains Gradle id rather than creating a private ineffective lock. Queue/report_blocked according to nextAction, release the lease on success/failure, and never clean shared output. Focused red command from Windows repo root: cmd /d /c "cd /d moe-jetbrains && gradlew.bat test --tests com.moe.services.PlanApprovalContractTest"; Unix: cd moe-jetbrains && ./gradlew test --tests com.moe.services.PlanApprovalContractTest. Record actual assertion failures for revision loss and swallowed transport exceptions, not compile/IPC/environment failures.

Implement the exact model/decoder contract without disturbing landed metadata. Append immutable planRevision: Long? = 0L at the end of Task's constructor to preserve existing call sites/parameter order; add a new shared MAX_SAFE_PLAN_REVISION: Long constant equal to 9007199254740991L in Models.kt. Document only the non-obvious distinction: absent legacy revision is effective zero; malformed present input is null/unusable and must never be defaulted to zero by a reviewed UI. Add a narrowly scoped private revision decoder in MoeJson and use it explicitly in BOTH Task constructors (parseTasks used by parseState, and public parseTask). Missing get returns 0L; present JsonNull or nonnumeric JSON kind returns null. Require JsonPrimitive.isNumber, parse the original decimal representation exactly as BigDecimal, compare against zero and the maximum before longValueExact(), and catch only number-format/arithmetic conversion errors as null. Do not route through existing getLongOrNull/asLong, integer coercion, floating-point conversion, rounding or a broad task-level catch. Integral exponent/decimal forms are valid numeric integers; true fractional values remain null even near the safe bound. Leave existing permissive getters and all other fields unchanged; do not merge the two parser implementations. Extend the same test class with direct typed Long?/default/copy assertions once the property exists while retaining the old-compilable field-loss regression.

Approval-specific error handling: Implement the approval transport contract and its tests as one reviewable sender/facade change (the production transport callback type must change on both ends together). Expose approveTask(taskId: String, expectedPlanRevision: Long? = null): Boolean in sender and service; the service delegates the caller's argument unchanged and never reads state/getState to obtain a newer revision. Validate every non-null argument with require in 0L..MAX_SAFE_PLAN_REVISION before connection checks or send; invalid values throw IllegalArgumentException and emit no packet. Null means omitted optional command metadata, not task-model validity: the reviewed consumer must reject a null Task revision, never forward it as a legacy approval. Preserve exact legacy payload {taskId} for omitted/null argument; only add numeric expectedPlanRevision when supplied, including explicit 0 and the maximum. Change injected send from (String,String)->Unit to (String,String)->Boolean; service transport captures wsClient once, returns false for missing/non-open socket, calls client.send(message) otherwise and returns true only after that call returns normally. Do not swallow send exceptions. In MoeCommandSender extract existing envelope construction into a new private unchecked Boolean dispatch helper used by approval. Keep public sendMessage's current best-effort/logging catch around that same helper for all unrelated commands, so this fix does not turn connection/background callbacks into throwing callers. approveTask returns false after ensureConnected refuses (existing onDisconnected once), and also calls onDisconnected once if transport returns false after the initial check; returns true only for a send, without approval events or state mutation; transport exceptions propagate unchanged to the dialog's later error path. Add sender JUnit tests for exact envelope/payload key sets and 0/normal/above-Int/max tokens, omitted/null key absence, disconnected false/no packet/one callback, post-check transport false/one callback, negatives and max+1/Long extremes throwing before any send, and sentinel exception identity with no claimed success. Prove unrelated sendMessage still uses its existing best-effort error behavior. To obtain serializer-specific old-behavior red evidence, expose the final signature/plumbing but keep the old revision-omitting payload for the first focused run of the explicit-zero test: capture the missing-key assertion failure, then add the conditional property; no compile failure counts as the regression. Complete that implementation before leaving the step. Keep concise KDoc on both public approveTask methods explaining omitted legacy metadata, local send result versus daemon acceptance, and thrown invalid/transport errors.

Finish production-facade integration coverage in PlanApprovalContractTest.kt; do not mock or replace MoeCommandSender or copy its serializer. Follow existing MoeProjectServiceTest fake IdeaProject Proxy and synchronous invokeLaterForTests pattern. Use a no-network WebSocketClient subclass (cached 1.6.0 API verified overridable isOpen(), send(String), close()) with captured strings, controlled open/closed state and sentinel throwing send; use test-local reflection on existing wsClient/connected/state fields as current service tests do, avoiding a new production test hook. Populate cached state with revision N+1, call actual service.approveTask(taskId,N), and assert the exact N packet and true result; cached Task status/revision and state-listener event counts must not claim daemon approval. Cover omitted legacy and explicit zero through the facade, missing client, connected=false, stale connected=true with non-open client, and a deterministic close/no-send between connected check and transport result. Assert false/no packet and exactly the existing (false, 'Not connected to daemon') notification, not silent success. Invalid Long tokens must throw with zero packets even when disconnected; transport sentinel exceptions must escape unchanged without true/approval state. For deterministic post-check loss use the sender's injected callbacks or the fake client's controlled isOpen side effect, not sleeps. Always remove listeners, dispose each service and close only fixture-owned transports in finally; do not start a daemon, network server or background connection threads. Preserve every existing MoeJson/connection test file unchanged. This completes DoD 3-4 through the real facade, parser and serializer, not a surrogate test algorithm.

Run ONE final full JetBrains regression verification because shared model/parser/wire changes require the complete package suite (DoD 5); the parent feature owns cross-package end-to-end/docs work. These fresh results are complete_task.verification evidence, not historical counts.

Check disposed/missing/non-open clients, listener cleanup, no live network/thread leaks, and preservation of landed blockers, budget removal and foreign WIP.
